news.title: Oil giant BP profits more than double due to Iran war - again
news.summary: Profit has again more than doubled at oil and gas giant BP as the war in Iran boosted fossil fuel prices.  Company profits hit $5.7bn (£4.2bn), up from $2.3bn (£1.7bn) a year earlier and even better than the $5bn analysts had been expecting.  It was a similar story the last time the producer announced quarterly results, when underlying profits topped $3.2bn (£2.366bn), as it benefited from the massive rise in crude oil prices caused by supply disruption in the key Middle East shipping lane, the Strait of Hormuz.
